description: What is machine-enforced versus convention. Token references in a PageSpec live ONLY in a node's optional, closed `style` object (added in pageSpecVersion 2.0.0) and the root `theme`; every rule below is enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py against tokens/llm/token-catalog.json, which is itself derived from the real token files.

machineEnforced.allowlistParity: extraction/verify_all.py — fails on a phantom entry or an orphaned contract.
machineEnforced.allowlistVersionParity: extraction/verify_all.py — this file, the allowlist and registry.manifest.json must agree.
machineEnforced.citationValidity: extraction/verify_all.py — every measuredFrom path:line range resolves inside the real file.
machineEnforced.manifestCounts: extraction/verify_all.py — recomputed from the files on disk, never trusted as written.
machineEnforced.pinnedAssetRolePolicies: extraction/verify_all.py — compliance-critical roles are pinned to a specific policy value, not merely a member of the enum.
machineEnforced.nodesMatchDeclaredTemplate: schema/semantic_validate.py — cross-references the declared template against its real node list.
machineEnforced.maxWordsBudgets: schema/semantic_validate.py — counted per instance, not just on the bundled example.
machineEnforced.rhythmRules: schema/semantic_validate.py, honouring each rule's severity in compatibility/graph.json.
machineEnforced.tokenCatalogInSync: extraction/verify_all.py — rebuilds the catalog from the token files (extraction/build_token_catalog.py) and fails on any difference.
machineEnforced.pinnedAssetAvailability: extraction/verify_all.py and schema/semantic_validate.py — PINNED_AVAILABILITY tables in code, cross-checked against assets/asset-roles.json.

conventionOnly.copyPolicy: Advisory. `verbatim-locked` marks copy measured from the real site; no script enforces that a generator honours it.
conventionOnly.evidenceLevel: Advisory. Records whether a template/section was measured or inferred.
conventionOnly.pageSpecVersion: Pinned by the schema (`const`), but bumping it is a hand-maintained documentation decision.

rawValueRestrictions.note: Category keys match token-catalog.json `counts` categories so a drift check can resolve them.
rawValueRestrictions.color: No raw hex / rgb / hsl in a PageSpec (TOKEN_RAW_COLOR). Reference a semantic.surface / semantic.text / semantic.border token.
rawValueRestrictions.radius: Reference radius.* (semantic) or radius.scale.* tokens only.
rawValueRestrictions.font: fontFamily must be font.sans or font.headline (TOKEN_UNSUPPORTED_FONT).
rawValueRestrictions.type: typeRole must be a type.* token.
rawValueRestrictions.elevation: Nothing to set — zero box-shadows site-wide; z-index stops are layout-owned.
rawValueRestrictions.motion: Only the closed motionFieldSet, with evidence-grounded easings and durations.

overrides.perInstanceTokenOverrides: The optional closed `style` object on a PageSpec node: {surface, text, border, radius, spacing, fontFamily, typeRole}. Values are token NAMES only.
overrides.history: 1.0.0 had no override field and recorded that as a gap. 2.0.0 adds the closed `style` object so token misuse is validated at the PageSpec layer (schema/tests/adversarial_test.py covers every TOKEN_* rule) in addition to the catalog drift check.

semanticTokenRules.TOKEN_UNKNOWN: A `style` value that is not a token name in token-catalog.json.
semanticTokenRules.TOKEN_RAW_COLOR: A raw hex / rgb() / rgba() / hsl() colour anywhere in a PageSpec (style values AND content strings).
semanticTokenRules.TOKEN_ARBITRARY_SPACING: A raw length (px / em / rem / % / vw / vh / ch) in a `style` slot instead of a spacing.* token.
semanticTokenRules.TOKEN_UNSUPPORTED_FONT: A `fontFamily` that is not one of token-catalog.json fontFamilies (font.sans, font.headline). The Typekit original face is never supported.
semanticTokenRules.TOKEN_THEME_COMBINATION: A token used in a slot of the wrong family (e.g. text.* in `surface`), or a theme-resolved slot whose token does not resolve in the declared theme, or a theme not listed in registry.manifest.json schemaValidatedThemes.
